name: Letter shatter

source.description: An inspected typographic piece breaks a large letter into angular shards.

technique: A solid glyph fractures into shards that fly apart with rotation, turning a letter into debris for emphasis or a transition.
purpose: Impact, breaking an idea, transition out of a type card.
visual_behaviour: A big letter splits into polygons that scatter and spin, leaving the frame or reforming.
mechanics: Clones of the glyph clipped to seeded polygon shards; per-shard x, y, rotation with power2.in; optional reverse to assemble.
failure_modes: Too few shards look like a cut, too many cost paint time

implementation.approach: Seeded triangulation of the glyph box, clip-path polygon per clone, Studio.space.disassemble for the scatter.

provenance.observed: A large letter A breaks into angular fragments.
